# Pull Request

## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses. Also include the relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue number, if applicable)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Improvement (non-breaking change that improves existing functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe below)

## How Has This Been Tested?

MARIHAR does not have an automated test suite yet (see the Roadmap), so manual testing is essential. Please describe how you verified your changes:

- [ ] Web interface (`python Backend/app.py`, opened in a browser)
- [ ] Desktop application (`python Backend/desktop_app.py`)
- [ ] Tested on Windows version: (e.g., Windows 10 22H2 / Windows 11)
- [ ] Python version used: (e.g., 3.8 / 3.12)

Test details:

1. ...
2. ...

Please avoid including private URLs in your test notes.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style of this project (naming, formatting, comments)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have updated the documentation if needed (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, user docs)
- [ ] I have updated the translation files (`en.json`, `fr.json`, `it.json`, `mg.json`) if I added or changed user-facing strings
- [ ] I have read and followed the guidelines in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Screenshots or recordings

If your pull request changes the user interface, please attach screenshots in both **Dark and Light modes** (drag & drop is supported) or a short recording to help reviewers.
